svg.title: About, as a terminal session
svg.desc: Terminal typing: whoami, Aashutosh Mahajan, AI and backend engineer. I build the layer underneath AI products: agents, ML systems and backend services that keep working after the demo ends. B.Tech in Information Technology at Vidyalankar Institute of Technology, CGPA 9.67, 2024 to 2028. 25+ hackathons, 6 national finals. Based in Mumbai, India.
